payout_quote: EarthBound, $344. Price List Updated Daily. All games and game collections are expected to be in overall salable condition with little to no damage and North American (NTSC) products.
steps: Open the DKOldies sell page on dkoldies.com and select the games or consoles you want to sell from the published price list.
Email or submit your list to get the per-item cash values confirmed.
Ship your games and systems using the free shipping label (for qualifying orders).
Receive cash payment once your items arrive and are checked; a 20% bonus is available if you choose store credit instead.
catches: Payout depends on the exact game, console and condition - you must own the items you sell; listed prices assume salable condition and North American (NTSC) products.
Price list is updated daily, so the value of your items can change; your printed price list is only honored if you ship within two business days.
Damaged or unrepairable items may receive partial or no credit, and damaged items are not returned.
biggest_catch: Payout depends entirely on which games or consoles you have and their condition - you must own them; the $344 figure is the listed price for one rare SNES game (EarthBound), not what ordinary games earn, and prices change daily.
eligibility: US; you must own the games or consoles you sell; items expected in salable condition, North American (NTSC) products.
timing: Payment after receipt and inspection; ~15-30 min active time to list items and ship.
